main_body: vertical stone column with capital, shaft, and base
top_band: light grey horizontal top surface of the capital at rows 9-12 with a bright front-edge line at row 12
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 8 is the top outline, rows 9-11 are the foreshortened light-grey top surface of the capital, and row 12 is a distinct lighter front-edge highlight (4 top rows total). Below that are rows 13-14 (shaded front face of the capital), rows 15-16 (dark overhang/eave shadow), rows 17-39 (vertical column shaft), and rows 40-47 (base).

style.evidence: The column uses a harsh colourless near-black outline along the sides and corners, and the entire 23-row shaft (rows 17-39) consists of identical extruded vertical bands with zero stone texture, joints, or speckle compared to the richly textured stone and wood of the Beodeul references. The base is also an exact copy-paste of the capital.
